description: CelVerifier.verify() surfaces T2's own decode rejection (unknown functionId).

contains(s, needle) with a 65536-byte needle literal: C(E) = 1 + 65536*65536 + 2 = 4294967299, far over maxExprCost (1000000) and exactly the 2^32-adjacent width STD-011 Sec 10.6 requires a >=64-bit cost accumulator to reject correctly.

AND(contains(recv1, "x"*15), startsWith(recv2, "y"*16954)): contains own cost = 1 + 65536*15 = 983041, + receiver(1) + needle(1) = 983043; startsWith own cost = 1 + 16954 = 16955, + receiver(1) + needle(1) = 16957; AND own cost = 1; C(E) = 1 + 983043 + 16957 = 1,000,001, exactly one over maxExprCost (1,000,000) -- mirrors CelVerifierCostGateTest.costOneOverCeiling_rejected's construction as a corpus vector.
'!' applied to a literal int operand.
'+' between a string literal and an int literal.
'%' applied to two double literals ('%' is int x int only, Sec 11.1).
List literal mixing int and string elements (STD-011 Sec 5.3.2 / Appendix B Sec B.6.6).
Unqualified field 'x' declared by two namespaces in the schema chain (STD-011 Sec 8.2).
Predicate root expression statically inferred int, not bool.
Transform declares scalar(STRING_T) but root is a literal int.
